## Comparing groups {.title-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Week 7</div>

<div class="concept-line" style="margin-top:1em;">
Are these groups meaningfully different?
</div>

::: {.notes}
Week 6 gave us the general inference machinery. This week is about choosing a statistic and a reference distribution that fit the data structure and scientific question.
:::

## We already know the recipe {.motivation-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">From Week 6</div>

<div class="recipe-flow fragment fade-up">
<div class="recipe-node observed-border"><strong>Observe</strong><span>sample statistic</span></div>
<div class="recipe-arrow">→</div>
<div class="recipe-node uncertainty-border"><strong>Standardize</strong><span>sampling variability</span></div>
<div class="recipe-arrow">→</div>
<div class="recipe-node estimate-border"><strong>Decide</strong><span>CI + test + effect</span></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Today we change the <strong>test statistic</strong> to match the data and the question.</div>
:::

## There is no universal test statistic {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Data structure matters</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Binary outcome</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\hat p$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">counts and proportions</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Continuous outcome</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\bar x, s$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">means and spreads</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Several groups</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\bar x_1 \, \text{vs.} \, \bar x_2$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">between vs within variability</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="warning-box"><div class="warning-title">The test name comes last</div><p>First identify the variable, sampling structure, parameter of interest, and comparison.</p></div>
:::

## The target is still the population {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Do not lose the inferential target</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Observed sample</div><div class="w7-card-sub">what happened in these patients</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Sampling model</div><div class="w7-card-sub">what would vary across repetitions</div></div>
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Population parameter</div><div class="w7-card-sub">what we want to learn about disease $D$</div></div>
</div>

## Choosing a test {.section-break}

<div class="section-kicker">Part I</div>
<div class="section-title">A test-selection blueprint</div>
<div class="section-subtitle">Choose from the data structure and scientific question.</div>

## Four questions get us surprisingly far {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">A practical blueprint</div>

<div class="choice-map fragment fade-up">
<div class="choice-step"><span>1</span><strong>Variable type?</strong><small>categorical or continuous</small></div>
<div class="choice-step"><span>2</span><strong>How many groups?</strong><small>one, two, or more</small></div>
<div class="choice-step"><span>3</span><strong>Paired?</strong><small>same units measured twice?</small></div>
<div class="choice-step"><span>4</span><strong>What parameter?</strong><small>location, spread, association, agreement</small></div>
</div>

## First branch: what kind of variable? {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">The arithmetic must make sense</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Categorical</div><div class="w7-card-sub">counts, proportions, contingency tables</div><div class="w7-card-math">$O-E$</div><img src="figures/categorical_data.jpg" alt="Categorical" class="w7-card-img"></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Continuous</div><div class="w7-card-sub">means, differences, variances</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\bar x,\;s^2$</div><img src="figures/continuous_data.jpg" alt="Continuous" class="w7-card-img"></div>
</div>

## Second branch: what comparison? {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Reference vs another group</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">One sample</div><div class="w7-card-sub">compare with a reference value or distribution</div><img src="figures/one_sample.jpg" alt="One sample" class="w7-card-img"></div>
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Two samples</div><div class="w7-card-sub">compare two populations</div><img src="figures/two_samples.jpg" alt="Two samples" class="w7-card-img"></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Three or more</div><div class="w7-card-sub">compare several means jointly</div><img src="figures/three_samples.jpg" alt="Three samples" class="w7-card-img"></div>
</div>

## Third branch: independent or paired? {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">What is the observational unit?</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Independent</div><div class="w7-card-sub">healthy patients and sick patients are different people</div><img src="figures/unpaired_samples.png" alt="Unpaired" class="w7-card-img"></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Paired</div><div class="w7-card-sub">the same patients measured before and after treatment $\text{T}$</div><img src="figures/paired_samples.png" alt="Paired" class="w7-card-img"></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">A paired analysis works on the <strong>within-subject differences</strong>.</div>
:::

## Fourth branch: location or spread? {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Different parameters answer different questions</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Location</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\mu,\;p$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">where is the population centered?</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Spread</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\sigma^2$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">how variable is the population?</div></div>
</div>

## Categorical outcomes {.section-break}

<div class="section-kicker">Part II</div>
<div class="section-title">Counts and proportions</div>
<div class="section-subtitle">The sampling object is a count, proportion, or contingency table.</div>

## One binary proportion vs a reference {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Exact binomial test</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Observed</div><div class="w7-card-math">$X$ haemophilic among $n$ sick patients</div></div>
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Reference world</div><div class="w7-card-math">$X\sim\mathrm{Binomial}(n,p_0)$</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Question: is the haemophilia proportion in sick patients different from $p_0=0.50$?</div>
:::

## Example: exact binomial test {.concept-slide}

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card">
<div class="test-name">Exact binomial test</div>
<div class="question">Is $p_{\text{haemophilia}}$ among sick patients different from $0.50$?</div>
<div class="result">Report: observed proportion + CI + exact p-value</div>
</div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cat_binomial.svg" alt="Exact binomial test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## One categorical distribution vs a reference {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Chi-squared goodness-of-fit</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Observed counts</div><div class="w7-card-math">$O_j$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Expected counts</div><div class="w7-card-math">$E_j=n p_{0j}$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Discrepancy</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\sum (O_j-E_j)^2/E_j$</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Example: are young / middle / old sick patients distributed as $\frac{1}{3}$, $\frac{1}{3}$, $\frac{1}{3}$?</div>
:::

## Example: goodness-of-fit {.concept-slide}

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">$\chi^2$ goodness-of-fit</div><div class="question">Does the observed age-group distribution match the reference distribution?</div><div class="result">Report observed vs expected proportions + $\chi^2$ + df + p</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cat_gof.svg" alt="GOF test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Two groups and a categorical outcome {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Homogeneity</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Fisher exact</div><div class="w7-card-sub">especially useful for small 2×2 tables</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Pearson $\chi^2$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">compares observed and expected cell counts from marginals</div></div>
</div>

## Example: healthy vs sick {.concept-slide}

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">Fisher / Pearson $\chi^2$</div><div class="question">Is haemophilia proportion different in healthy and sick groups?</div><div class="result">Report contingency table + risk/proportion difference CI + p-value</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cat_two_groups.svg" alt="Chi-squared homogeneity test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Paired binary outcome {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">McNemar's test</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Before</div><div class="w7-card-sub">haemophilia classification at baseline</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">After</div><div class="w7-card-sub">same subjects after treatment</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Only the <strong>discordant pairs</strong> carry information about directional change.</div>
:::

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">McNemar</div><div class="question">Did the binary classification change after treatment in the same subjects?</div><div class="result">Report discordant transitions + paired proportion difference + p</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cat_mcnemar.svg" alt="McNemar test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Categorical synthesis {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Reconstruct the choice</div>

<div class="test-family-table fragment fade-up" style="font-size: 110%">
<div class="head">question</div><div class="head">design</div><div class="head">statistic</div><div class="head">test</div>
<div>binary $p$ vs $p_0$</div><div>one sample</div><div>count $X$</div><div>exact binomial</div>

<div>proportions across groups</div><div>independent</div><div>contingency table</div><div>Fisher / Pearson $\chi^2$</div>

</div>

## Continuous outcomes {.section-break}

<div class="section-kicker">Part III</div>
<div class="section-title">Means and variances</div>
<div class="section-subtitle">Now the parameters are population location and spread.</div>

## One mean vs a reference {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">One-sample Student's $t$</div>

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">One-sample Student $t$</div><div class="question">Is mean hemoglobin in sick patients different from $130$ g/L?</div><div class="result">$t=(\bar x-130)/(s/\sqrt n)$</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cont_one_mean.svg" alt="One mean test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## One variance vs a reference {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Chi-squared test for one variance</div>

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">One-variance $\chi^2$</div><div class="question">Is population SD different from $10$ g/L?</div><div class="result">$(n-1)s^2/\sigma_0^2\sim\chi^2_{n-1}$ under Normality</div><div class="caution">This test is especially sensitive to non-Normal data.</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cont_one_variance.svg" alt="One variance test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Two independent means {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Welch's two-sample $t$ test</div>

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">Welch $t$</div><div class="question">Is mean hemoglobin different in healthy and sick populations?</div><div class="result">difference in means + SE using both group variances</div><div class="caution">Welch is the default here: it does not require equal population variances.</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cont_welch.svg" alt="Welch test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Two independent variances {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Classical $F$ variance-ratio test</div>

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">Variance ratio</div><div class="question">Is hemoglobin variability different in healthy and sick populations?</div><div class="result">$F=s_1^2/s_2^2$ · infer a <strong>ratio</strong> of variances</div><div class="caution">The classical $F$ test is strongly sensitive to non-Normality.</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cont_f_variance.svg" alt="F test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Paired continuous means {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Paired $t$ = one-sample $t$ on differences</div>

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">Paired Student $t$</div><div class="question">Did mean hemoglobin change after treatment in the same old subjects?</div><div class="result">define $D_i=post_i-pre_i$, then test $E(D)=0$</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cont_paired_t.svg" alt="Paired t test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Paired continuous variances {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Pitman–Morgan test</div>

<div class="test-example-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="test-result-card"><div class="test-name">Pitman–Morgan</div><div class="question">Did population variability change between paired pre/post measurements?</div><div class="result">tests equality of two variances when measurements are paired</div><div class="caution">This is a specialized Normal-theory method; use only when the variance question is scientifically meaningful.</div></div>
<div class="test-figure">
<img src="figures/cont_pitman_morgan.svg" alt="Pitman Morgan test result" class="test-figure-img">
</div>
</div>

## Parametric tests come with a model {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Assumptions are part of the inferential claim</div>

<div class="assumption-stack fragment fade-up">
<div class="assumption-row"><strong>Independence / sampling design</strong><span>usually more fundamental than the exact shape of the histogram</span></div>
<div class="assumption-row"><strong>Distributional shape</strong><span>for small samples, strong skew and outliers can matter; paired tests concern the distribution of differences</span></div>
<div class="assumption-row"><strong>Variance structure</strong><span>Welch relaxes equal-variance assumptions for the two-sample mean problem</span></div>
<div class="assumption-row"><strong>Model adequacy</strong><span>inspect the data and residual structure rather than using a separate normality test as a mechanical gatekeeper</span></div>
</div>

## Normality is not a yes/no property of a sample {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Inspect shape, tails, and outliers</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Histogram</div><div class="w7-card-sub">global shape</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">QQ plot</div><div class="w7-card-sub">quantiles and tail departures</div></div>
<div class="w7-card warning-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Context</div><div class="w7-card-sub">sample size, outliers, balance, scientific plausibility</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Moderate or large samples often make mean-based methods robust to mild non-Normality.</div>
:::

## How a QQ plot works {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Quantile against quantile</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Theoretical quantile</div><div class="w7-card-sub">where a Normal observation should fall</div></div>
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Sample quantile</div><div class="w7-card-sub">where the ordered observation actually falls</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Near a line</div><div class="w7-card-sub">approximately compatible with Normal location-scale shape</div></div>
</div>

## Specific tests, worked visually {.section-break}

<div class="section-kicker">Part IV</div>
<div class="section-title">From formula to reference distribution</div>
<div class="section-subtitle">Two worked tests make the general Week 6 machinery concrete.</div>

## Welch's $t$: standardize a difference in means {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Two independent continuous groups</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Difference</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\bar x_A-\bar x_B$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Standard error</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\sqrt{s_A^2/n_A+s_B^2/n_B}$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Welch statistic</div><div class="w7-card-math">$t=\frac{\bar x_A-\bar x_B}{SE}$</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">The degrees of freedom are adjusted because the two variances are estimated separately.</div>
:::

## What Welch's test is saying {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Keep three outputs together</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Estimate</div><div class="w7-card-sub">how large is the mean difference?</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Interval</div><div class="w7-card-sub">which population differences are compatible?</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">p-value</div><div class="w7-card-sub">how extreme is the standardized difference under $H_0$?</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">The test does not replace effect size or scientific interpretation.</div>
:::

## Chi-squared contingency tests: compare observed with expected {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">The null model builds the expected table</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Observed</div><div class="w7-card-math">$O_{ij}$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Expected under independence</div><div class="w7-card-math">$E_{ij}=\frac{R_iC_j}{N}$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Sum discrepancies</div><div class="w7-card-math">$X^2=\sum\frac{(O-E)^2}{E}$</div></div>
</div>

## Expected counts are part of the approximation {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Small tables need care</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Reasonable expected counts</div><div class="w7-card-sub">the chi-squared approximation can work well</div></div>
<div class="w7-card warning-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Sparse cells</div><div class="w7-card-sub">exact methods or alternative models may be preferable</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">This is why Fisher's exact test remains useful for small 2×2 tables.</div>
:::

## ANOVA {.section-break}

<div class="section-kicker">Part V</div>
<div class="section-title">More than two means</div>
<div class="section-subtitle">Why an analysis of variance answers a question about means.</div>

## Why “analysis of variance” for a mean question? {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">The core logic</div>

<div class="variance-decomp fragment fade-up">
<div class="observed-border"><strong>Within groups</strong><span>natural patient-to-patient variability</span></div>
<div class="variance-arrow">vs</div>
<div class="estimate-border"><strong>Between groups</strong><span>dose groups have different centers</span></div>
<div class="variance-arrow">→</div>
<div class="uncertainty-border"><strong class="inline-label"><strong style="font-size: 170%">$F$</strong>ratio</strong><span>signal relative to noise</span></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">If group means are truly equal, between-group variability should not dwarf within-group variability.</div>
:::

## ANOVA decomposes total variability {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">One-way ANOVA</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Total Sum-of-Squares</div><div class="w7-card-math">$SS_T$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">all deviations from grand mean</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Between Sum-of-Squares</div><div class="w7-card-math">$SS_B$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">group means vs grand mean</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Within Sum-of-Squares</div><div class="w7-card-math">$SS_W$</div><div class="w7-card-sub">individuals vs their group mean</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">$SS_T=SS_B+SS_W$ and $F=MS_B/MS_W$.</div>
:::

## A significant ANOVA is an omnibus statement {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">At least one mean differs</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">ANOVA</div><div class="w7-card-sub">tests the global null that all means are equal</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Tukey</div><div class="w7-card-sub">all pairwise comparisons</div></div>
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Dunnett</div><div class="w7-card-sub">each treatment against a chosen reference</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Post-hoc comparisons answer “which groups?” while controlling multiplicity.</div>
:::

## Factorial models are not six separate t tests {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">The model asks structured questions</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Main effect</div><div class="w7-card-sub">a systematic average shift</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Interaction</div><div class="w7-card-sub">departure from additivity</div></div>
<div class="w7-card warning-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Do not over-slice</div><div class="w7-card-sub">many unplanned pairwise tests recreate multiplicity problems</div></div>
</div>

## Agreement and equivalence {.section-break}

<div class="section-kicker">Part VI</div>
<div class="section-title">When “no important difference” is the goal</div>
<div class="section-subtitle">Association, agreement, equivalence, and interchangeability are different claims.</div>

## Association is not agreement {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">A hierarchy of questions</div>

<div class="agreement-spectrum fragment fade-up">
<div class="agreement-node observed-border"><strong>Association</strong><span>do the variables contain information about each other?</span></div>
<div class="agreement-arrow">→</div>
<div class="agreement-node estimate-border"><strong>Agreement</strong><span>do measurements / ratings coincide?</span></div>
<div class="agreement-arrow">→</div>
<div class="agreement-node uncertainty-border"><strong>Interchangeability</strong><span>are differences small enough for practical replacement?</span></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">A high correlation can coexist with poor agreement.</div>
:::

## Categorical agreement: Cohen's kappa {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Two diagnosticians, same patients</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Observed agreement</div><div class="w7-card-math">$P_o$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Chance agreement</div><div class="w7-card-math">$P_e$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Excess agreement</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\kappa=\frac{P_o-P_e}{1-P_e}$</div></div>
</div>

<div class="mathematician-gallery fragment fade-up">
  <div class="portrait-card">
  <img src="figures/Cohen.jpg" alt="Jacob Cohen">
  <div class="portrait-name">Jacob Cohen</div>
  </div>
  <div class="portrait-card">
  <img src="figures/Krippendorff.jpg" alt="Klaus Krippendorff">
  <div class="portrait-name">Klaus Krippendorff</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="kappa-table">

  <div class="head">Doctor 1 +</div><input id="kapA" type="number" value="42" min="0"><input id="kapB" type="number" value="8" min="0">

  </div>
<div>
<div class="kappa-output"><div class="w7-output"><span class="inline-label" style="font-size: 120%"><span>observed</span><span style="font-size: 110%">$P_o$</span></span><strong id="kapPoOut">—</strong></div><div class="w7-output"><span class="inline-label" style="font-size: 120%"><span>chance</span><span style="font-size: 110%">$P_e$</span></span><strong id="kapPeOut">—</strong></div><div class="w7-output"><span class="inline-label" style="font-size: 120%"><span style="font-size: 110%">$\kappa$</span></span><strong id="kapOut">—</strong></div></div>
<div class="kappa-gauge"><div id="kapNeedle" class="needle"></div></div>
<div class="kappa-scale"><span>−1</span><span>0</span><span>1</span></div>
<div class="concept-line" style="font-size:.48em;margin-top:.5em;">Kappa adjusts raw agreement for agreement expected from the marginal prevalences.</div>
</div>
</div>

## Equivalence reverses the usual null logic {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Generic vs originator</div>

<div class="equiv-logic fragment fade-up">
<div class="equiv-node warning-border"><strong class="inline-label" style="font-size: 110%"><strong>Choose</strong><strong style="font-size: 110%">$\Delta$</strong><strong>first</strong></strong><span>largest scientifically acceptable difference</span></div>
<div class="equiv-arrow">→</div>
<div class="equiv-node uncertainty-border"><strong>Test both boundaries</strong><span class="inline-label">difference must be above<span style="font-size: 190%">$-\Delta$</span>and below<span style="font-size: 190%">$+\Delta$</span></span></div>
<div class="equiv-arrow">→</div>
<div class="equiv-node estimate-border"><strong>Conclude equivalence</strong><span>only if both one-sided tests reject</span></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="warning-box"><div class="warning-title">Not “prove the difference is zero”</div><p>Exact equality is not the target. Equivalence means the population difference is sufficiently small relative to a pre-specified scientific margin.</p></div>
:::

## Four confidence-interval situations {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Equivalence margin $[-\Delta,+\Delta]$</div>

<div class="equiv-cases fragment fade-up">
<div class="equiv-case"><strong>Equivalent and includes 0</strong><div class="equiv-track"><span class="zero"></span><span class="ci" style="left:35%;width:28%;"></span><span class="point" style="left:49%;"></span></div><small>entire 90% CI lies inside the equivalence margin</small></div>
<div class="equiv-case"><strong>Equivalent but different from 0</strong><div class="equiv-track"><span class="zero"></span><span class="ci" style="left:55%;width:16%;"></span><span class="point" style="left:63%;"></span></div><small>statistical difference can coexist with practical equivalence</small></div>
<div class="equiv-case"><strong>Not equivalent, includes 0</strong><div class="equiv-track"><span class="zero"></span><span class="ci" style="left:15%;width:56%;"></span><span class="point" style="left:47%;"></span></div><small>too imprecise to establish equivalence</small></div>
<div class="equiv-case"><strong>Neither equivalent nor close to 0</strong><div class="equiv-track"><span class="zero"></span><span class="ci" style="left:70%;width:22%;"></span><span class="point" style="left:81%;"></span></div><small>difference extends beyond the acceptable margin</small></div>
</div>

aria-label="Equivalence confidence interval">

</div>
</div>
</div>

## Interchangeability asks more than mean equivalence {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Bland–Altman logic</div>

<div class="w7-grid-3 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card observed-border"><div class="w7-card-title">For each subject</div><div class="w7-card-math">$d_i=A_i-B_i$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card model-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Bias</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\bar d$</div></div>
<div class="w7-card uncertainty-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Limits of agreement</div><div class="w7-card-math">$\bar d\pm1.96s_d$</div></div>
</div>

<div class="mathematician-gallery fragment fade-up">
  <div class="portrait-card">
  <img src="figures/Bland.jpg" alt="Martin Bland">
  <div class="portrait-name">Martin Bland</div>
  </div>
  <div class="portrait-card">
  <img src="figures/Altman.jpg" alt="Douglas G Altman">
  <div class="portrait-name">Douglas G. Altman</div>
  </div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">The question is whether <strong>individual differences</strong>, not just the mean difference, are acceptably small.</div>
:::

## Bland–Altman patterns {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Four qualitatively different situations</div>

<div class="ba-grid fragment fade-up">
<div class="ba-figure"><img src="figures/ba_good.svg" alt="BA good" class="ba-figure-img"></div>
<div class="ba-figure"><img src="figures/ba_bias.svg" alt="BA good" class="ba-figure-img"></div>
<div class="ba-figure"><img src="figures/ba_hetero.svg" alt="BA good" class="ba-figure-img"></div>
<div class="ba-figure"><img src="figures/ba_wide.svg" alt="BA good" class="ba-figure-img"></div>
</div>

## Correlation would miss the point {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Agreement is a difference question</div>

<div class="w7-grid-2 fragment fade-up">
<div class="w7-card warning-border"><div class="w7-card-title">High correlation</div><div class="w7-card-sub">measurements can move together while one is systematically 10 units higher</div></div>
<div class="w7-card estimate-border"><div class="w7-card-title">Good agreement</div><div class="w7-card-sub">individual differences are centered and clinically acceptably narrow</div></div>
</div>

## Choose the test {.exercise-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Prediction exercise</div>

<div class="question-card fragment fade-up">
<div class="scenario">A single group of $80$ patients has a binary adverse-event outcome. You want to know whether the population event proportion differs from the historical value $0.10$.</div>
<div class="ask">Which inferential structure fits?</div>
<div class="answer-grid"><div>Welch $t$</div><div>exact binomial</div><div>McNemar</div><div>ANOVA</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="w7-callout estimate-callout"><strong>Exact binomial:</strong> one binary proportion compared with a reference probability.</div>
:::

## Choose the test: paired data {.exercise-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Prediction exercise</div>

<div class="question-card fragment fade-up">
<div class="scenario">The same $45$ patients have hemoglobin measured immediately before and after treatment. The question is whether the mean within-patient change is zero.</div>
<div class="ask">What statistic should you build first?</div>
<div class="answer-grid"><div>two independent means</div><div>within-patient differences</div><div>variance ratio</div><div>contingency table</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="w7-callout estimate-callout">Compute $D_i=post_i-pre_i$, then perform a one-sample $t$ analysis on the differences.</div>
:::

## Read the output, not just the p-value {.exercise-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Interpretation exercise</div>

<div class="question-card fragment fade-up">
<div class="scenario">Difference in means = $-1.8$ g/L, 95% CI $[-5.5,1.9]$, p = $0.34$.</div>
<div class="ask">Which statement is defensible?</div>
<div class="answer-grid"><div>the means are proven equal</div><div>there is no clinically meaningful effect</div><div>the data are compatible with a range of negative and positive effects</div><div>$H_0$ has probability $0.34$</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="w7-callout uncertainty-callout">The interval is the key: the study is compatible with several population effects. “Not significant” is not proof of equality.</div>
:::

<div><strong>3 · Identify parameter</strong><span>proportion, mean, variance, agreement</span></div>
<div><strong>4 · Choose machinery</strong><span>statistic + reference distribution + CI</span></div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){

/* =========================================================
   SHARED NUMERICAL HELPERS
   ========================================================= */

let qqSeed = 0;

function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)); }
function mulberry32(seed){ return function(){ let t=seed+=0x6D2B79F5;t=Math.imul(t^t>>>15,t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,t|61);return ((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;}; }
function randn(rng){ let u=0,v=0;while(u===0)u=rng();while(v===0)v=rng();return Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*v); }
function normPdf(x,mu=0,s=1){ const z=(x-mu)/s;return Math.exp(-.5*z*z)/(s*Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI)); }
function logGamma(z){ const g=7,p=[0.99999999999980993,676.5203681218851,-1259.1392167224028,771.32342877765313,-176.61502916214059,12.507343278686905,-0.13857109526572012,9.9843695780195716e-6,1.5056327351493116e-7];if(z<.5)return Math.log(Math.PI)-Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI*z))-logGamma(1-z);z-=1;let x=p[0];for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++)x+=p[i]/(z+i);const t=z+g+.5;return .5*Math.log(2*Math.PI)+(z+.5)*Math.log(t)-t+Math.log(x); }
function tPdf(x,nu){ const a=logGamma((nu+1)/2)-logGamma(nu/2)-.5*Math.log(nu*Math.PI);return Math.exp(a-((nu+1)/2)*Math.log(1+x*x/nu)); }
function chiPdf(x,k){ if(x<=0)return 0;return Math.exp((k/2-1)*Math.log(x)-x/2-(k/2)*Math.log(2)-logGamma(k/2)); }
function axis(x1,y1,x2,y2,cls='w7-axis'){ return `<line x1="${x1}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2}" y2="${y2}" class="${cls}"></line>`; }
function pathFrom(points,cls){ return `<path d="${points.map((p,i)=>`${i?'L':'M'} ${p[0].toFixed(1)} ${p[1].toFixed(1)}`).join(' ')}" class="${cls}"></path>`; }
function fmtP(p){ if(!Number.isFinite(p))return '—';if(p<.001)return '&lt;0.001';return p.toFixed(3); }

function betacf(a,b,x){ const MAXIT=200,EPS=3e-12,FPMIN=1e-300;let qab=a+b,qap=a+1,qam=a-1,c=1,d=1-qab*x/qap;if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN;d=1/d;let h=d;for(let m=1;m<=MAXIT;m++){let m2=2*m;let aa=m*(b-m)*x/((qam+m2)*(a+m2));d=1+aa*d;if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN;c=1+aa/c;if(Math.abs(c)<FPMIN)c=FPMIN;d=1/d;h*=d*c;aa=-(a+m)*(qab+m)*x/((a+m2)*(qap+m2));d=1+aa*d;if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN;c=1+aa/c;if(Math.abs(c)<FPMIN)c=FPMIN;d=1/d;const del=d*c;h*=del;if(Math.abs(del-1)<EPS)break;}return h; }
function betai(a,b,x){ if(x<=0)return 0;if(x>=1)return 1;const bt=Math.exp(logGamma(a+b)-logGamma(a)-logGamma(b)+a*Math.log(x)+b*Math.log(1-x));return x<(a+1)/(a+b+2)?bt*betacf(a,b,x)/a:1-bt*betacf(b,a,1-x)/b; }
function tCdf(t,nu){ const x=nu/(nu+t*t),ib=betai(nu/2,.5,x);return t>=0?1-.5*ib:.5*ib; }
function tInv(p,nu){ let lo=-20,hi=20;for(let i=0;i<90;i++){const mid=(lo+hi)/2;if(tCdf(mid,nu)<p)lo=mid;else hi=mid;}return (lo+hi)/2; }
function gammaQ(a,x){ if(x<0||a<=0)return NaN;if(x===0)return 1;const ITMAX=200,EPS=3e-12,FPMIN=1e-300;if(x<a+1){let ap=a,sum=1/a,del=sum;for(let n=1;n<=ITMAX;n++){ap++;del*=x/ap;sum+=del;if(Math.abs(del)<Math.abs(sum)*EPS)break;}const p=sum*Math.exp(-x+a*Math.log(x)-logGamma(a));return 1-p;}let b=x+1-a,c=1/FPMIN,d=1/b,h=d;for(let i=1;i<=ITMAX;i++){const an=-i*(i-a);b+=2;d=an*d+b;if(Math.abs(d)<FPMIN)d=FPMIN;c=b+an/c;if(Math.abs(c)<FPMIN)c=FPMIN;d=1/d;const del=d*c;h*=del;if(Math.abs(del-1)<EPS)break;}return Math.exp(-x+a*Math.log(x)-logGamma(a))*h; }
function chiSurvival(x,df){ return gammaQ(df/2,x/2); }
function chiInv(p,df){ let lo=0,hi=Math.max(10,df+10*Math.sqrt(2*df));while(1-chiSurvival(hi,df)<p)hi*=2;for(let i=0;i<90;i++){const mid=(lo+hi)/2;const cdf=1-chiSurvival(mid,df);if(cdf<p)lo=mid;else hi=mid;}return (lo+hi)/2; }
function fCdf(x,d1,d2){ if(x<=0)return 0;return betai(d1/2,d2/2,(d1*x)/(d1*x+d2)); }

/* Acklam inverse Normal approximation */
function normInv(p){ if(p<=0)return -Infinity;if(p>=1)return Infinity;const a=[-39.6968302866538,220.946098424521,-275.928510446969,138.357751867269,-30.6647980661472,2.50662827745924],b=[-54.4760987982241,161.585836858041,-155.698979859887,66.8013118877197,-13.2806815528857],c=[-.00778489400243029,-.322396458041136,-2.40075827716184,-2.54973253934373,4.37466414146497,2.93816398269878],d=[.00778469570904146,.32246712907004,2.445134137143,3.75440866190742],pl=.02425,ph=1-pl;let q,r;if(p<pl){q=Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(p));return (((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5])/((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);}if(p>ph){q=Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(1-p));return -(((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5])/((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);}q=p-.5;r=q*q;return (((((a[0]*r+a[1])*r+a[2])*r+a[3])*r+a[4])*r+a[5])*q/(((((b[0]*r+b[1])*r+b[2])*r+b[3])*r+b[4])*r+1); }

/* =========================================================
   QQ WIDGET
   ========================================================= */

let qqCache={values:[],theo:[],dist:'normal',n:80};

function qqDrawSample(){
  const dist=document.getElementById('qqDist')?.value||'normal';
  const n=Number(document.getElementById('qqN')?.value||80);
  const out=document.getElementById('qqNValue');if(out)out.textContent=n;
  const rng=mulberry32(7100+qqSeed*1009+(dist==='right'?100:dist==='left'?200:dist==='bimodal'?300:0));
  const values=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    let x;
    if(dist==='normal')x=randn(rng);
    else if(dist==='right')x=-Math.log(Math.max(1e-12,1-rng()))-1;
    else if(dist==='left')x=1+Math.log(Math.max(1e-12,1-rng()));
    else x=(rng()<.5?-1.8:1.8)+.65*randn(rng);
    values.push(x);
  }
  values.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const theo=values.map((_,i)=>normInv((i+.5)/n));
  qqCache={values,theo,dist,n};
  renderQQ(-1);
}

function renderQQ(active=-1){
  const svg=document.getElementById('qqSvg');if(!svg||!qqCache.values.length)return;
  const vals=qqCache.values,theo=qqCache.theo,n=vals.length;
  const W=900,H=500;
  const qL=70,qR=625,qT=105,qB=445;
  const topT=18,topB=82;
  const histL=660,histR=870;
  const xMin=-3.3,xMax=3.3;
  let yMin=Math.min(...vals),yMax=Math.max(...vals);const yr=yMax-yMin||1;yMin-=.08*yr;yMax+=.08*yr;
  const mx=x=>qL+((x-xMin)/(xMax-xMin))*(qR-qL);
  const my=y=>qB-((y-yMin)/(yMax-yMin))*(qB-qT);
  const sampleMean=vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n;
  const sampleSd=Math.sqrt(vals.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x-sampleMean)**2,0)/(n-1));
  let html='';
  // main grid
  [-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3].forEach(t=>{const x=mx(t);html+=axis(x,qT,x,qB,'w7-gridline');html+=`<text x="${x}" y="${qB+22}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-label">${t}</text>`;});
  const yTicks=5;for(let j=0;j<=yTicks;j++){const v=yMin+j*(yMax-yMin)/yTicks,y=my(v);html+=axis(qL,y,qR,y,'w7-gridline');html+=`<text x="${qL-10}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" class="w7-small-label">${v.toFixed(1)}</text>`;}
  html+=axis(qL,qB,qR,qB)+axis(qL,qT,qL,qB);
  html+=`<text x="${(qL+qR)/2}" y="485" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-title-label">theoretical Normal quantile</text>`;
  html+=`<text x="18" y="${(qT+qB)/2}" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 18 ${(qT+qB)/2})" class="w7-title-label">sample quantile</text>`;
  // reference line
  const refPts=[xMin,xMax].map(x=>[mx(x),my(sampleMean+sampleSd*x)]);html+=pathFrom(refPts,'qq-reference');
  // top theoretical density
  const densPts=[];for(let x=xMin;x<=xMax;x+=.04){densPts.push([mx(x),topB-(normPdf(x)/.42)*(topB-topT)]);}html+=pathFrom(densPts,'qq-normal');html+=axis(qL,topB,qR,topB);
  html+=`<text x="${qL}" y="14" class="w7-small-label">theoretical Normal density</text>`;
  // right sample histogram along y
  const bins=18,counts=Array(bins).fill(0);vals.forEach(v=>{let b=Math.floor(((v-yMin)/(yMax-yMin))*bins);b=clamp(b,0,bins-1);counts[b]++;});const cMax=Math.max(...counts,1);
  for(let b=0;b<bins;b++){const y1=my(yMin+(b+1)*(yMax-yMin)/bins),y2=my(yMin+b*(yMax-yMin)/bins);const w=(counts[b]/cMax)*(histR-histL);html+=`<rect x="${histL}" y="${y1}" width="${w}" height="${Math.max(1,y2-y1-1)}" class="qq-hist"></rect>`;}
  html+=axis(histL,qT,histL,qB);html+=`<text x="${histL}" y="${qT-10}" class="w7-small-label">sample distribution</text>`;
  // active highlights
  if(active>=0&&active<n){
    const ax=mx(theo[active]),ay=my(vals[active]);
    html+=`<rect x="${qL}" y="${topT}" width="${Math.max(0,ax-qL)}" height="${topB-topT}" class="qq-highlight"></rect>`;
    const b=clamp(Math.floor(((vals[active]-yMin)/(yMax-yMin))*bins),0,bins-1);const hy1=my(yMin+(b+1)*(yMax-yMin)/bins),hy2=my(yMin+b*(yMax-yMin)/bins);html+=`<rect x="${histL}" y="${hy1}" width="${histR-histL}" height="${Math.max(1,hy2-hy1)}" class="qq-highlight"></rect>`;
    html+=axis(ax,qT,ax,qB,'qq-crosshair')+axis(qL,ay,qR,ay,'qq-crosshair');
  }
  // points last
  vals.forEach((v,i)=>{html+=`<circle cx="${mx(theo[i])}" cy="${my(v)}" r="${i===active?5:3.2}" class="qq-point${i===active?' active':''}"></circle>`;});
  svg.innerHTML=html;
  const pOut=document.getElementById('qqProbOut'),tOut=document.getElementById('qqTheoOut'),sOut=document.getElementById('qqSampleOut');
  if(active>=0){const p=(active+.5)/n;if(pOut)pOut.textContent=`${(100*p).toFixed(1)}%`;if(tOut)tOut.textContent=theo[active].toFixed(2);if(sOut)sOut.textContent=vals[active].toFixed(2);}else{if(pOut)pOut.textContent='move cursor';if(tOut)tOut.textContent='—';if(sOut)sOut.textContent='—';}
}

function qqPointer(e) {
  const svg = document.getElementById("qqSvg");
  if (!svg ||!qqCache.theo.length) {return;}
  const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
  if (!ctm) return;
  let point;
  if (typeof DOMPoint === "function") {
    point =
      new DOMPoint(
        e.clientX,
        e.clientY
      ).matrixTransform(
        ctm.inverse()
      );
  } else {
    const p = svg.createSVGPoint();
    p.x = e.clientX;
    p.y = e.clientY;
    point = p.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse());
  }
  const x = point.x;
  const y = point.y;
  const qL = 70;
  const qR = 625;
  const qT = 105;
  const qB = 445;
  if (x < qL || x > qR || y < qT || y > qB) {
    renderQQ(-1);
    return;
  }
  const xMin = -3.3;
  const xMax = 3.3;
  const theoreticalX = xMin + ((x - qL) / (qR - qL)) * (xMax - xMin);
  let best = 0;
  let bestDistance = Infinity;
  qqCache.theo.forEach(
    (q, i) => {
      const distance = Math.abs(q - theoreticalX);
      if (distance < bestDistance) {
        bestDistance = distance;
        best = i;
      }
    }
  );
  renderQQ(best);
}

/* =========================================================
   WELCH T WIDGET
   ========================================================= */

function renderWelch(){
  const m1=Number(document.getElementById('welchM1')?.value||0),s1=Math.max(.001,Number(document.getElementById('welchS1')?.value||1)),n1=Math.max(2,Number(document.getElementById('welchN1')?.value||2));
  const m2=Number(document.getElementById('welchM2')?.value||0),s2=Math.max(.001,Number(document.getElementById('welchS2')?.value||1)),n2=Math.max(2,Number(document.getElementById('welchN2')?.value||2));
  const diff=m1-m2,a=s1*s1/n1,b=s2*s2/n2,se=Math.sqrt(a+b),t=diff/se,df=(a+b)*(a+b)/(a*a/(n1-1)+b*b/(n2-1));
  const p=2*(1-tCdf(Math.abs(t),df)),crit=tInv(.975,df),lo=diff-crit*se,hi=diff+crit*se;
  
  document.getElementById('welchDiffOut').textContent=diff.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('welchSeOut').textContent=se.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('welchTOut').textContent=t.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('welchDfOut').textContent=df.toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('welchPOut').innerHTML=fmtP(p);
  document.getElementById('welchCiOut').textContent=`[${lo.toFixed(1)}, ${hi.toFixed(1)}]`;

  const svg=document.getElementById('welchSvg');if(!svg)return;
  const L=55,R=855,top=35,base=245,xMin=-5,xMax=5; // Adjusted top to 35 for region labels
  const mx=x=>L+((x-xMin)/(xMax-xMin))*(R-L);
  let yMax=0;for(let x=xMin;x<=xMax;x+=.03)yMax=Math.max(yMax,tPdf(x,df));
  const my=y=>base-(y/(yMax*1.12))*(base-top);

  let html=axis(L,base,R,base);
  [-4,-2,0,2,4].forEach(x=>{
    html+=axis(mx(x),base,mx(x),base+6);
    html+=`<text x="${mx(x)}" y="${base+24}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-label">${x}</text>`;
  });

  function area(a0,b0){
    const aa=Math.max(xMin,a0),bb=Math.min(xMax,b0);if(bb<=aa)return'';
    let d=`M ${mx(aa)} ${base} L ${mx(aa)} ${my(tPdf(aa,df))}`;
    for(let x=aa+.03;x<=bb;x+=.03)d+=` L ${mx(x)} ${my(tPdf(x,df))}`;
    d+=` L ${mx(bb)} ${my(tPdf(bb,df))} L ${mx(bb)} ${base} Z`;
    return d;
  }

  html+=`<path d="${area(xMin,-crit)}" class="rejection-fill"></path><path d="${area(crit,xMax)}" class="rejection-fill"></path>`;
  const pts=[];for(let x=xMin;x<=xMax;x+=.03)pts.push([mx(x),my(tPdf(x,df))]);
  html+=pathFrom(pts,'density-null');

  [-crit,crit].forEach(c=>{if(c>=xMin&&c<=xMax)html+=axis(mx(c),top,mx(c),base,'critical-line');});
  
  // ---------------------------------------------------------
  // Hypothesis Decision Labels (Tails = Reject, Center = Retain)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------
  const leftTailMid = (xMin - crit) / 2;
  const rightTailMid = (xMax + crit) / 2;
  
  html += `<text x="${mx(leftTailMid)}" y="${top - 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="welch-decision-label reject">Reject H₀</text>`;
  html += `<text x="${mx(0)}" y="${top - 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="welch-decision-label retain">Do not reject H₀</text>`;
  html += `<text x="${mx(rightTailMid)}" y="${top - 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="welch-decision-label reject">Reject H₀</text>`;

  const tc=clamp(t,xMin,xMax);
  html+=axis(mx(tc),top,mx(tc),base,'observed-line');
  html+=`<text x="${mx(tc)}" y="${top - 24}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-title-label">observed t = ${t.toFixed(2)}</text>`;

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------
    95% CI panel
  --------------------------------------------------------- */
  const y = 390;
  const ciMin = -10, ciMax = 10;
  const cix = x => L + ((x - ciMin) / (ciMax - ciMin)) * (R - L);
  const clipCI = x => clamp(x, ciMin, ciMax);
  const loDraw = clipCI(lo), hiDraw = clipCI(hi), diffDraw = clipCI(diff);

  html += axis(L, y, R, y);
  [-10, -5, 0, 5, 10].forEach(v => {
    const x = cix(v);
    html += axis(x, y, x, y + 6);
    html += `<text x="${x}" y="${y + 28}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-label">${v}</text>`;
  });

  html += axis(cix(0), y - 40, cix(0), y + 15, "ci-zero");
  html += axis(cix(loDraw), y, cix(hiDraw), y, "ci-line");
  html += `<circle cx="${cix(diffDraw)}" cy="${y}" r="6" fill="#1f6feb" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"></circle>`;
  html += `<text x="${L}" y="${y - 32}" class="w7-title-label">95% CI for mean difference</text>`;
  html += `<text x="${cix(loDraw)}" y="${y + 48}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-small-label">${lo.toFixed(1)}</text>`;
  html += `<text x="${cix(hiDraw)}" y="${y + 48}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-small-label">${hi.toFixed(1)}</text>`;

  svg.innerHTML=html;
}

/* =========================================================
   CHI-SQUARE CONTINGENCY WIDGET
   ========================================================= */

function renderChiTable() {
  // 1. Read Inputs & Configure Layout
  const layout = document.getElementById('chiLayout')?.value || '2x2';
  const cols = layout === '2x3' ? 3 : 2;
  const alpha = Number(document.getElementById('chiAlpha')?.value || 0.05);
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.chi-col3').forEach(el => {
    el.style.display = cols === 3 ? '' : 'none';
  });

  const a = [
    Number(document.getElementById('chiA1')?.value || 0),
    Number(document.getElementById('chiA2')?.value || 0),
    Number(document.getElementById('chiA3')?.value || 0)
  ].slice(0, cols);

  const b = [
    Number(document.getElementById('chiB1')?.value || 0),
    Number(document.getElementById('chiB2')?.value || 0),
    Number(document.getElementById('chiB3')?.value || 0)
  ].slice(0, cols);

  const rows = [a, b];
  const rowT = rows.map(r => r.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0));
  const colT = Array.from({ length: cols }, (_, j) => a[j] + b[j]);
  const N = rowT[0] + rowT[1];

  if (N <= 0) return;

  // 2. Calculate Expected Frequencies and Chi-Square Statistic
  const expected = [[], []];
  let stat = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
      const e = (rowT[i] * colT[j]) / N;
      expected[i][j] = e;
      if (e > 0) {
        stat += Math.pow(rows[i][j] - e, 2) / e;
      }
    }
  }

  const df = cols - 1;
  const p = chiSurvival(stat, df);
  const crit = chiInv(1 - alpha, df);

  // 3. Update DOM Text Outputs
  document.getElementById('chiStatOut').textContent = stat.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('chiDfOut').textContent = df;
  document.getElementById('chiPOut').innerHTML = fmtP(p);

  const ex = document.getElementById('chiExpected');
  if (ex) {
    ex.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;
    ex.innerHTML = expected
      .flat()
      .map((e, i) => `<div>E${i + 1}=${e.toFixed(1)}</div>`)
      .join('');
  }

  // 4. Prepare SVG Canvas & Scale Mappers
  const svg = document.getElementById('chiTableSvg');
  if (!svg) return;

  const L = 55;
  const R = 855;
  const top = 35; // Increased top margin for decision labels
  const base = 355;
  const xMin = 0;
  const xMax = Math.max(8, crit * 1.5, stat * 1.25, df + 6 * Math.sqrt(2 * df));

  const mx = x => L + (x / xMax) * (R - L);
  const step = xMax / 400;

  let yMax = 0;
  for (let x = 0.01; x <= xMax; x += step) {
    yMax = Math.max(yMax, chiPdf(x, df));
  }
  const my = y => base - (y / (yMax * 1.12)) * (base - top);

  function area(a0, b0) {
    const aa = Math.max(0, a0);
    const bb = Math.min(xMax, b0);
    let d = `M ${mx(aa)} ${base} L ${mx(aa)} ${my(chiPdf(Math.max(0.001, aa), df))}`;
    for (let x = aa + step; x <= bb; x += step) {
      d += ` L ${mx(x)} ${my(chiPdf(x, df))}`;
    }
    d += ` L ${mx(bb)} ${my(chiPdf(bb, df))} L ${mx(bb)} ${base} Z`;
    return d;
  }

  // 5. Build SVG Elements
  let html = axis(L, base, R, base);

  // Rejection Area & Density Path
  html += `<path d="${area(crit, xMax)}" class="rejection-fill"></path>`;

  const pts = [];
  for (let x = 0.01; x <= xMax; x += step) {
    pts.push([mx(x), my(chiPdf(x, df))]);
  }
  html += pathFrom(pts, 'chi-density');

  // Critical & Observed Lines
  const clampedStat = clamp(stat, 0, xMax);
  html += axis(mx(crit), top, mx(crit), base, 'critical-line');
  html += axis(mx(clampedStat), top, mx(clampedStat), base, 'observed-line');

  // Decision Region Labels (Left = Retain, Right = Reject)
  const retainMid = crit / 2;
  const rejectMid = (crit + xMax) / 2;

  html += `<text x="${mx(retainMid)}" y="${top - 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="chi-decision-label retain">Do not reject H₀</text>`;
  html += `<text x="${mx(rejectMid)}" y="${top - 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="chi-decision-label reject">Reject H₀</text>`;

  // X-Axis Ticks and Labels
  [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].forEach(f => {
    const v = f * xMax;
    const x = mx(v);
    html += axis(x, base, x, base + 6);
    html += `<text x="${x}" y="${base + 24}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-label">${v.toFixed(1)}</text>`;
  });

  // Plot Titles
  html += `<text x="${mx(clampedStat)}" y="${top - 24}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-title-label">observed X² = ${stat.toFixed(2)}</text>`;
  html += `<text x="${mx(crit)}" y="${base - 30}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-small-label">critical ${crit.toFixed(2)}</text>`;

  svg.innerHTML = html;
}

/* =========================================================
   ONE-WAY ANOVA WIDGET
   ========================================================= */

function renderAnova(){
  const means=[1,2,3].map(i=>Number(document.getElementById(`anovaM${i}`)?.value||0)),sd=Math.max(.001,Number(document.getElementById('anovaSd')?.value||1)),n=Math.max(2,Number(document.getElementById('anovaN')?.value||2)),k=3;
  const grand=means.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/k,ssb=n*means.reduce((s,m)=>s+(m-grand)**2,0),ssw=k*(n-1)*sd*sd,dfb=k-1,dfw=k*n-k,msb=ssb/dfb,msw=ssw/dfw,F=msb/msw,p=1-fCdf(F,dfb,dfw);
  document.getElementById('anovaSsbOut').textContent=ssb.toFixed(1);document.getElementById('anovaSswOut').textContent=ssw.toFixed(1);document.getElementById('anovaMsbOut').textContent=msb.toFixed(1);document.getElementById('anovaFOut').textContent=F.toFixed(2);document.getElementById('anovaPOut').innerHTML=fmtP(p);
  const svg=document.getElementById('anovaSvg');if(!svg)return;const W=900,H=460,L=85,R=855,top=35,base=390,xs=[220,450,680],labels=['low','medium','high'];let yMin=Math.min(...means)-2.7*sd,yMax=Math.max(...means)+2.7*sd;const my=y=>base-((y-yMin)/(yMax-yMin))*(base-top);let html=axis(L,base,R,base)+axis(L,top,L,base);for(let j=0;j<=5;j++){const v=yMin+j*(yMax-yMin)/5,y=my(v);html+=axis(L,y,R,y,'w7-gridline')+`<text x="${L-10}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" class="w7-label">${v.toFixed(0)}</text>`;}
  html+=axis(L,my(grand),R,my(grand),'anova-grand')+`<text x="${R}" y="${my(grand)-7}" text-anchor="end" class="w7-small-label">grand mean ${grand.toFixed(1)}</text>`;
  const meanPts=[];means.forEach((m,i)=>{const x=xs[i],q1=m-.674*sd,q3=m+.674*sd,wlo=m-1.5*sd,whi=m+1.5*sd;html+=`<rect x="${x-42}" y="${my(q3)}" width="84" height="${my(q1)-my(q3)}" class="anova-box"></rect>`;html+=axis(x-42,my(m),x+42,my(m),'anova-median')+axis(x,my(whi),x,my(wlo),'anova-whisker')+axis(x-18,my(whi),x+18,my(whi),'anova-whisker')+axis(x-18,my(wlo),x+18,my(wlo),'anova-whisker');const se=sd/Math.sqrt(n),crit=tInv(.975,n-1),lo=m-crit*se,hi=m+crit*se;html+=axis(x,my(lo),x,my(hi),'ci-line')+`<circle cx="${x}" cy="${my(m)}" r="6" class="anova-mean-point"></circle><text x="${x}" y="${base+28}" text-anchor="middle" class="w7-title-label">${labels[i]}</text>`;meanPts.push([x,my(m)]);});html+=pathFrom(meanPts,'anova-mean-line');svg.innerHTML=html;
}

/* =========================================================
   FACTORIAL INTERACTION WIDGET
   ========================================================= */

function renderFactorial() {

  const base =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('facBase')?.value || 72
    );

  const med =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('facMed')?.value || -2
    );

  const high =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('facHigh')?.value || -6
    );

  const smoke =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('facSmoke')?.value || 3
    );

  const intMed =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('facIntMed')?.value || 0
    );

  const intHigh =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('facIntHigh')?.value || 5
    );

  const sd =
    Math.max(
      .1,
      Number(
        document.getElementById('facSd')?.value || 6
      )
    );

  const n =
    Math.max(
      2,
      Number(
        document.getElementById('facN')?.value || 30
      )
    );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Live labels
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  [
    ['facBaseValue', base],
    ['facMedValue', med],
    ['facHighValue', high],
    ['facSmokeValue', smoke],
    ['facIntMedValue', intMed],
    ['facIntHighValue', intHigh],
    ['facSdValue', sd],
    ['facNValue', n]
  ].forEach(([id, value]) => {

    const el =
      document.getElementById(id);

    if (el) {
      el.textContent = value;
    }
  });


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Cell means

     Reference cell:
     non-smoker + low dose

     Interactions modify the smoker dose response
     beyond simple additivity.
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const nons = [
    base,
    base + med,
    base + high
  ];


  const smok = [
    base + smoke,

    base +
      smoke +
      med +
      intMed,

    base +
      smoke +
      high +
      intHigh
  ];


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Two-way ANOVA interaction test
     
     balanced 3 × 2 design
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const a = 3;   // dose levels
  const b = 2;   // smoking levels


  const cells = [
    nons,
    smok
  ];


  const grand =
    cells
      .flat()
      .reduce(
        (sum, x) => sum + x,
        0
      ) /
    (a * b);


  /* dose marginal means */

  const doseMeans =
    [0, 1, 2].map(j =>
      (
        nons[j] +
        smok[j]
      ) / 2
    );


  /* smoking marginal means */

  const smokingMeans = [
    nons.reduce(
      (sum, x) => sum + x,
      0
    ) / a,

    smok.reduce(
      (sum, x) => sum + x,
      0
    ) / a
  ];


  /*
   * Interaction SS:
   *
   * departure of each cell mean from what would
   * be expected from additive main effects.
   */

  let ssInteraction = 0;


  for (let i = 0; i < b; i++) {

    for (let j = 0; j < a; j++) {

      const residual =
        cells[i][j] -
        doseMeans[j] -
        smokingMeans[i] +
        grand;


      ssInteraction +=
        n *
        residual *
        residual;
    }
  }


  const dfInteraction =
    (a - 1) *
    (b - 1);       // = 2


  const dfError =
    a *
    b *
    (n - 1);


  /*
   * common within-cell SD gives pooled MSE
   */

  const mse =
    sd * sd;


  const msInteraction =
    ssInteraction /
    dfInteraction;


  const F =
    msInteraction /
    mse;


  const p =
    Math.max(
      0,
      Math.min(
        1,
        1 -
        fCdf(
          F,
          dfInteraction,
          dfError
        )
      )
    );


  const fOut =
    document.getElementById(
      'facFOut'
    );

  const pOut =
    document.getElementById(
      'facPOut'
    );


  if (fOut) {

    fOut.textContent =
      `F(${dfInteraction}, ${dfError}) = ${F.toFixed(2)}`;
  }


  if (pOut) {

    pOut.innerHTML =
      fmtP(p);
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Mean confidence intervals
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const se =
    sd /
    Math.sqrt(n);


  /*
   * pooled residual df from factorial ANOVA
   */

  const crit =
    tInv(
      .975,
      dfError
    );


  const halfCI =
    crit *
    se;


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     SVG geometry
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const svg =
    document.getElementById(
      'factorialSvg'
    );

  if (!svg) return;


  const L = 80;
  const R = 840;

  const top = 48;
  const baseY = 385;

  const xs = [
    180,
    450,
    720
  ];

  const labels = [
    'low',
    'medium',
    'high'
  ];


  const allMeans =
    nons.concat(smok);


  /*
   * y-scale depends on mean positions and SD,
   * but NOT on n.
   *
   * Therefore changing n visibly changes CI width.
   */

  const yPad =
    Math.max(
      8,
      .75 * sd
    );


  const yMin =
    Math.min(...allMeans) -
    yPad;


  const yMax =
    Math.max(...allMeans) +
    yPad;


  const my = y =>
    baseY -
    (
      (y - yMin) /
      (yMax - yMin)
    ) *
    (baseY - top);


  let html =
    axis(
      L,
      baseY,
      R,
      baseY
    ) +
    axis(
      L,
      top,
      L,
      baseY
    );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     horizontal grid
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  for (let j = 0; j <= 5; j++) {

    const value =
      yMin +
      j *
      (yMax - yMin) /
      5;


    const y =
      my(value);


    html +=
      axis(
        L,
        y,
        R,
        y,
        'w7-gridline'
      );


    html += `
      <text
        x="${L - 10}"
        y="${y + 4}"
        text-anchor="end"
        class="w7-label">
        ${value.toFixed(0)}
      </text>
    `;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     CI helper
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  function drawCI(
    x,
    mean,
    cls
  ) {

    const lo =
      mean -
      halfCI;

    const hi =
      mean +
      halfCI;


    let out = "";


    out +=
      axis(
        x,
        my(lo),
        x,
        my(hi),
        cls
      );


    out +=
      axis(
        x - 9,
        my(lo),
        x + 9,
        my(lo),
        cls
      );


    out +=
      axis(
        x - 9,
        my(hi),
        x + 9,
        my(hi),
        cls
      );


    return out;
  }


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     95% mean CIs
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  nons.forEach(
    (mean, i) => {

      html +=
        drawCI(
          xs[i] - 8,
          mean,
          'factor-ci-a'
        );
    }
  );


  smok.forEach(
    (mean, i) => {

      html +=
        drawCI(
          xs[i] + 8,
          mean,
          'factor-ci-b'
        );
    }
  );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Mean trajectories
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const pa =
    nons.map(
      (mean, i) => [
        xs[i],
        my(mean)
      ]
    );


  const pb =
    smok.map(
      (mean, i) => [
        xs[i],
        my(mean)
      ]
    );


  html +=
    pathFrom(
      pa,
      'factor-line-a'
    );


  html +=
    pathFrom(
      pb,
      'factor-line-b'
    );


  pa.forEach(p => {

    html += `
      <circle
        cx="${p[0]}"
        cy="${p[1]}"
        r="6"
        class="factor-point-a">
      </circle>
    `;
  });


  pb.forEach(p => {

    html += `
      <circle
        cx="${p[0]}"
        cy="${p[1]}"
        r="6"
        class="factor-point-b">
      </circle>
    `;
  });


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     dose labels
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  labels.forEach(
    (label, i) => {

      html += `
        <text
          x="${xs[i]}"
          y="${baseY + 28}"
          text-anchor="middle"
          class="w7-title-label">
          ${label}
        </text>
      `;
    }
  );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Proper two-row legend
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const legendX =
    R - 145;

  const legendY =
    top + 10;


  html += `
    <line
      x1="${legendX - 32}"
      y1="${legendY}"
      x2="${legendX - 8}"
      y2="${legendY}"
      class="factor-line-a">
    </line>

    <text
      x="${legendX}"
      y="${legendY + 5}"
      class="factor-legend-a">
      non-smoker
    </text>

    <line
      x1="${legendX - 32}"
      y1="${legendY + 25}"
      x2="${legendX - 8}"
      y2="${legendY + 25}"
      class="factor-line-b">
    </line>

    <text
      x="${legendX}"
      y="${legendY + 30}"
      class="factor-legend-b">
      smoker
    </text>
  `;


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     top note
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  html += `
    <text
      x="${L}"
      y="20"
      class="w7-small-label">
      cell means ± 95% CI · n=${n} per cell · common SD=${sd.toFixed(1)}
    </text>
  `;


  svg.innerHTML =
    html;
}

/* =========================================================
   KAPPA WIDGET
   ========================================================= */

function renderKappa(){
  const a=Number(document.getElementById('kapA')?.value||0),b=Number(document.getElementById('kapB')?.value||0),c=Number(document.getElementById('kapC')?.value||0),d=Number(document.getElementById('kapD')?.value||0),N=a+b+c+d;if(N<=0)return;
  const po=(a+d)/N,r1=(a+b)/N,r2=(c+d)/N,c1=(a+c)/N,c2=(b+d)/N,pe=r1*c1+r2*c2,k=(1-pe)>1e-12?(po-pe)/(1-pe):NaN;
  document.getElementById('kapPoOut').textContent=po.toFixed(3);document.getElementById('kapPeOut').textContent=pe.toFixed(3);document.getElementById('kapOut').textContent=Number.isFinite(k)?k.toFixed(3):'—';const needle=document.getElementById('kapNeedle');if(needle&&Number.isFinite(k))needle.style.left=`${clamp((k+1)/2*100,0,100)}%`;
}

/* =========================================================
   EQUIVALENCE WIDGET
   ========================================================= */

function renderEquiv(){

  const m1 =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('eqM1')?.value || 0
    );

  const m2 =
    Number(
      document.getElementById('eqM2')?.value || 0
    );

  const sd =
    Math.max(
      .001,
      Number(
        document.getElementById('eqSd')?.value || 1
      )
    );

  const n =
    Math.max(
      2,
      Number(
        document.getElementById('eqN')?.value || 2
      )
    );

  const delta =
    Math.max(
      .001,
      Number(
        document.getElementById('eqDelta')?.value || 1
      )
    );


  const diff = m2 - m1;

  const se =
    sd *
    Math.sqrt(2 / n);

  const df =
    2 * n - 2;

  const crit =
    tInv(.95, df);

  const lo =
    diff - crit * se;

  const hi =
    diff + crit * se;

  const equiv =
    lo > -delta &&
    hi < delta;


  document.getElementById('eqDiffOut').textContent =
    diff.toFixed(2);

  document.getElementById('eqCiOut').textContent =
    `[${lo.toFixed(2)}, ${hi.toFixed(2)}]`;

  document.getElementById('eqMarginOut').textContent =
    `±${delta.toFixed(2)}`;


  const dec =
    document.getElementById('eqDecisionOut');

  dec.textContent =
    equiv
      ? 'equivalent'
      : 'not established';

  dec.style.color =
    equiv
      ? '#18864b'
      : '#c93838';


  const svg =
    document.getElementById('equivSvg');

  if (!svg) return;


  const L = 65;
  const R = 850;
  const base = 205;


  const xAbs =
    Math.max(
      delta * 1.8,
      Math.abs(lo) * 1.35,
      Math.abs(hi) * 1.35,
      1
    );

  const xMin =
    -xAbs;

  const xMax =
    xAbs;


  const mx = x =>
    L +
    (
      (x - xMin) /
      (xMax - xMin)
    ) *
    (R - L);


  let html = `
    <rect
      x="${mx(-delta)}"
      y="75"
      width="${mx(delta) - mx(-delta)}"
      height="130"
      class="equiv-band">
    </rect>
  `;


  /* x-axis */

  html +=
    axis(
      L,
      base,
      R,
      base
    );


  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Numeric x-axis ticks
     ------------------------------------------------------- */

  const tickStep = 1;

  const firstTick =
    Math.ceil(xMin / tickStep) *
    tickStep;

  for (
    let v = firstTick;
    v <= xMax;
    v += tickStep
  ) {

    const x =
      mx(v);

    html +=
      axis(
        x,
        base,
        x,
        base + 6
      );

    html += `
      <text
        x="${x}"
        y="${base + 25}"
        text-anchor="middle"
        class="w7-label">
        ${v.toFixed(0)}
      </text>
    `;
  }


  /* equivalence boundaries */

  html +=
    axis(
      mx(-delta),
      55,
      mx(-delta),
      base,
      'equiv-bound'
    );

  html +=
    axis(
      mx(delta),
      55,
      mx(delta),
      base,
      'equiv-bound'
    );


  /* zero */

  html +=
    axis(
      mx(0),
      55,
      mx(0),
      base,
      'equiv-zero-line'
    );


  /* confidence interval */

  html +=
    axis(
      mx(lo),
      135,
      mx(hi),
      135,
      'equiv-ci'
    );


  /* point estimate */

  html += `
    <circle
      cx="${mx(diff)}"
      cy="135"
      r="7"
      class="equiv-point">
    </circle>
  `;


  /* equivalence-limit labels */

  html += `
    <text
      x="${mx(-delta)}"
      y="45"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="w7-title-label">
      −Δ
    </text>

    <text
      x="${mx(delta)}"
      y="45"
      text-anchor="middle"
      class="w7-title-label">
      +Δ
    </text>
  `;


  html += `
    <text
      x="${L}"
      y="30"
      class="w7-small-label">
      90% CI: equivalent only if the entire interval is inside the pre-specified margin
    </text>
  `;


  svg.innerHTML =
    html;
}

/* =========================================================
   INITIALIZATION
   ========================================================= */

function bindOnce(id,event,fn){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
  const key=`w7${event}`;if(el.dataset[key]==='1')return;el.dataset[key]='1';el.addEventListener(event,fn);
}

function initWeek07(){
  qqDrawSample();
  renderWelch();
  renderChiTable();
  renderAnova();
  renderFactorial();
  renderKappa();
  renderEquiv();

  bindOnce('qqDist','change',qqDrawSample);bindOnce('qqN','input',qqDrawSample);
  const qb=document.getElementById('qqRedraw');if(qb&&qb.dataset.w7click!=='1'){qb.dataset.w7click='1';qb.addEventListener('click',()=>{qqSeed++;qqDrawSample();});}
  bindOnce('qqSvg','pointermove',qqPointer);bindOnce('qqSvg','pointerleave',()=>renderQQ(-1));

  ['welchM1','welchS1','welchN1','welchM2','welchS2','welchN2'].forEach(id=>bindOnce(id,'input',renderWelch));
  bindOnce('chiLayout','change',renderChiTable);bindOnce('chiAlpha','change',renderChiTable);['chiA1','chiA2','chiA3','chiB1','chiB2','chiB3'].forEach(id=>bindOnce(id,'input',renderChiTable));
  ['anovaM1','anovaM2','anovaM3','anovaSd','anovaN'].forEach(id=>bindOnce(id,'input',renderAnova));
  ['facBase','facMed','facHigh','facSmoke','facIntMed','facIntHigh','facSd','facN'].forEach(id=>bindOnce(id,'input',renderFactorial));
  ['kapA','kapB','kapC','kapD'].forEach(id=>bindOnce(id,'input',renderKappa));
  ['eqM1','eqM2','eqSd','eqN','eqDelta'].forEach(id=>bindOnce(id,'input',renderEquiv));
}

function startWeek07(){ requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(initWeek07)); }

startWeek07();
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',startWeek07);
window.addEventListener('load',startWeek07);
if(window.Reveal&&typeof window.Reveal.on==='function'){
  window.Reveal.on('ready',startWeek07);
  window.Reveal.on('slidechanged',startWeek07);
}

})();
</script>
